claim_text: Always stretch your body after waking up to boost circulation.

adjudication.claim_text: Always stretch your body after waking up to boost circulation.
adjudication.reason: The supplied verification contains unresolved or heterogeneous component evidence and concludes insufficient evidence. Missing support is not converted into refutation.
adjudication.summary: Stretching can produce local vascular responses under particular conditions, but the supplied evidence does not establish that everyone should always stretch after waking to boost circulation. Missing direct support is not proof that the claim is false.

components.explanation: Some protocols show local vascular responses; others show nonsignificant changes or context-specific reduced flow. Endpoints, populations and phases differ. This is qualitative heterogeneity, not a pooled effect estimate.

The supplied sources do not establish an isolated post-waking stretching routine. Morning scheduling alone does not document timing relative to waking. No exact delay or superiority over other times is imposed.
Selected physiological experiments and general activity guidance do not justify always. This does not establish that stretching is unsafe or ineffective.
